epic.title: Epic #568 — spine ownership and lifecycle
epic.intent_and_why: Make engine state carry location and ownership, remain correct under concurrency, and die when its owner does.

definition_of_done: Every positive fix has a pre-fix failure and post-fix proof.
Linux and non-Windows CI are green; Windows-only failures are recorded but allowed.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Serialized engine-core implementation and independent review.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Live repro, focused and broader tests, exact CI evidence, verified merge.
good_enough.appetite: Five authorized items, with lifecycle required to float if materially complex.

hard_constraints: Only one implementation Commander at a time edits checklist_engine.py, spine_rail.py, or agent_work_root.py.
Lower-tier agents do not adjudicate architecture or final engine-core review.
fixed_decisions: Windows-only failures are non-blocking; non-Windows failures block.
Merges require exact-head pinning and independent APPROVE.

current_wave.objective: Land #530, #510, and Codex tier routing on evidence, after the wave-2 gate refused all three on locally reproduced Linux failures.
exit_criteria: Every item closes on red/green proof or honest measured null.
Each lane's full Linux suite passes in a cache-clean worktree before publication.
Independent review approves every positive change and states which suite it actually ran.
Linux and non-Windows CI are green; Windows-only failures recorded but allowed.

wave_evidence.claim: The pre-change wording was correct at that gate
wave_evidence.observed: Falsified. The pre-change wording is also wrong at g3, so neither string is pinnable

wave_evidence.claim: The wave-2 merge gate needed its cause-based amendment to land these lanes
wave_evidence.expected: Both PRs would rely on it
wave_evidence.observed: #579 needed it (5 added failures, all carrying the baseline InstallError signature). #580 did not: its set difference was empty in both directions
